title: Give us a way to disable the notifications triggered when file operations are started/completed but allow the users to use all their features via Notifications applet
line: A new "Show popups" option for application progress keeps file operations in the notifications applet without popping up, except when they fail.
explanation: Every job (copy, move, delete…) showed a popup when it started and was raised again when it finished. The only setting, "Show in notifications", removed jobs from the applet entirely, together with Pause, Cancel and Open Containing Folder, and Do Not Disturb deliberately doesn't mute jobs. The change adds a "Show popups" checkbox under Application progress (Jobs/Popups in plasmanotifyrc, default on): when off, a job starts minimized in the applet's history, as if its popup had been minimized, and is only raised when it finishes with an error. The re-raise on finish moved from JobPrivate::finish() into the jobs model so it can check the setting.

commits.message:
notifications: add option to not show popups for application jobs

File operations always popped up when they started and finished, and the
only way to stop that was hiding them from the applet too. A new "Show
popups" setting starts jobs hidden in history, raising them only on error.

BUG: 425355

media.caption: Before: a running copy job always pops up
After, with Show popups off: no popup, progress only on the applet icon
Before: the finished job pops up again
After, with Show popups off: nothing pops up when it finishes
Before: the only choices are showing jobs in notifications or not at all
After: new "Show popups" checkbox under Application progress
After: the running job is still in the applet with Pause, Cancel, Details and a restore button
After: finished jobs stay in the applet history with Open Containing Folder
After: a failed job still pops up even with Show popups off
